name: Portfolio Template
creator: Kyno
description: A modern portfolio website template built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Features smooth page transitions, project case studies, and a minimal aesthetic that lets your work take center stage. Deploy to Vercel in minutes.
features: 6 pre-built pages (Home, About, Projects, Project Detail, Blog, Contact)
Framer Motion page transitions and scroll animations
Fully responsive with dark/light mode toggle
SEO optimized with Next.js metadata API
